supersedes_evidence_usage: historical results/final_rigor is retained for audit only; it must not be mixed into v2 aggregates
reason: The historical seed-7 final_rigor artifact lacks authoritative non-seed CLI/config provenance. Rather than infer those settings after seeing seed-7 outcomes, v2 freezes every material field now and requires all five precommitted seeds, including seed 7, to be run from scratch under one identical protocol.

environment.execution_policy: CPU only; deterministic flag required; one intra-op and one inter-op Torch thread as implemented by the frozen source; record a fresh environment receipt with every run

seed_policy: No substitution, dropping, or rerunning only favorable seeds. Failed/adverse seeds remain part of the evidence package. All variants use the same seed set.

data.split_policy: chronological slices produced by build_datasets: first num_train valid windows, then num_val, then num_test; no shuffling across splits

training.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation score as implemented in frozen train.py

variant_semantics.no_memory: memory disabled by frozen benchmark/train variant path
variant_semantics.no_gate: gate override fixed to 1.0 by frozen benchmark/train variant path
variant_semantics.no_regime: regime loss weight set to 0.0 by frozen benchmark/train variant path

execution.command: python -m eigen_jepa.benchmark --deterministic --device cpu --seeds 7 19 31 43 59 --variants full no_memory no_gate no_regime --num_assets 12 --total_steps 240 --context_len 20 --horizon 6 --num_train 140 --num_val 36 --num_test 36 --k 3 --epochs 8 --batch_size 16 --lr 0.0008 --wd 0.0001 --d_model 64 --n_heads 4 --n_layers 2 --dropout 0.10 --latent_dim 64 --memory_size 128 --memory_top_k 4 --memory_temperature 0.18 --merge_radius 0.16 --min_salience 0.20 --market_style equity --regime_weight 0.75 --gate_weight 0.05 --tail_boost 1.5 --event_quantile 0.70 --mask_ratio 0.25 --block_time 4 --data_source synthetic --eig_weight 1.0 --subspace_weight 2.0 --drift_weight 0.5 --risk_weight 0.25 --entropy_weight 0.15 --rank_weight 0.15 --out_dir results/final_rigor_v2
execution.install_command: python -m pip install -r requirements/final_rigor_v2.txt && python -m pip install --no-deps -e .
execution.environment_receipt_command: python -VV && python -m pip freeze && python -c "import platform, numpy, torch, matplotlib; print(platform.platform()); print('numpy', numpy.__version__); print('torch', torch.__version__); print('matplotlib', matplotlib.__version__); print('cuda_available', torch.cuda.is_available()); print('threads', torch.get_num_threads(), torch.get_num_interop_threads())"

aggregation.mean: statistics.mean across the five retained seed-level test metrics
aggregation.std: statistics.pstdev across the five retained seed-level test metrics

outcome_access_rule: Do not inspect newly generated v2 outcome metrics until this protocol, its direct dependency lock, and its exact-output verifier are merged or otherwise immutably timestamped. Once outcome access begins, do not alter this protocol in response to results.
claim_rule: The historical single-seed result remains audit evidence only. Paper robustness/submission claims may be reconsidered only after all five v2 seeds and all four variants complete, adverse/failed runs are retained, scripts/check_final_rigor_v2.py prints FINAL_RIGOR_V2_PASS, and the manuscript is re-audited against the resulting aggregate. A weaker, null, or reversed result must be reported rather than repaired by changing this gate.
